author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
A couple in British Columbia keeps getting phone calls about their “missing cat.” Small problem: their cat isn’t missing. Or real.

Their phone number ended up on a high-fashion shirt featuring a fake missing cat poster, and now strangers keep calling just to say they haven’t seen the cat. Honestly, the most realistic part is that no one wants to talk in person — they’d rather call.
